levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي» : bare أبي is a relation; «قالا» makes him and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan co-transmitters
The bracketed «[بْنُ]» in «عبد الله [بن] جعفر» is the text's own editorial insertion: kept as written
Abu Ja'far is named inside the chain after «عن»: a narrator, not an imam_in_text (ruling 2)
The blessings after the names are not part of the surfaces
